units.source_text: 可是，信辅很是贫穷，没办法随心所欲的买自己想要阅读的书。

en.t: However, Shinsuke was very poor and could not freely buy the books he wanted to read.

units.source_text: 因此，他想办法来解决这个难题，第一是图书馆，第二是租书店，第三是让别人讥讽的省吃俭用。

en.t: So he found ways to solve this difficult problem: first, the library; second, rental bookshops; and third, the kind of frugality that made other people laugh at him.

units.source_text: 他始终清楚的记得面对大水沟的租书店，租书店里的慈祥老婆婆，还有老婆婆做簪花的副业。

en.t: He always remembered clearly the rental bookshop facing the large drainage ditch, the kindly old woman in the shop, and her side work making ornamental hairpins.

units.source_text: 老婆婆认为这个刚上小学的“小少爷”是单纯的。

en.t: The old woman thought this young master, who had just started elementary school, was innocent.

units.source_text: 但是，这个“小少爷”却在不知不觉中学会了假装在找书，实际是在偷看书的办法。

en.t: But before he knew it, this young master had learned how to pretend to be looking for books while actually reading them on the sly.

units.source_text: 他也清楚的记得，二十年前的神保町，旧书店布满整条街，阳光常常照耀在旧书店屋顶后面的九段斜坡。

en.t: He also clearly remembered Jinbocho twenty years earlier, when secondhand bookshops filled the whole street and sunlight often shone on the Kudan slope behind their roofs.

units.source_text: 不必多说，当时的神保町不仅没有电车，就连马车也没有。

en.t: Needless to say, Jinbocho at that time had no streetcars, and not even horse-drawn carriages.

units.source_text: 他，一个十二岁的小学生为了去大桥图书馆，总是在胳膊下夹着便当和笔记本，频繁的往返奔走在那条街上。

en.t: He, a twelve-year-old elementary school student, would tuck his lunch and notebook under his arm and hurry back and forth along that street again and again on his way to the Ohashi Library.

units.source_text: 从大桥图书馆到帝国图书馆，两者相距约莫一里半的路程。

en.t: From the Ohashi Library to the Imperial Library was a distance of roughly one and a half ri.

units.source_text: 他对帝国图书馆的第一印象很深——他害怕挑高的天花板，害怕高大的窗子，害怕坐满无数椅子的无数看书人。

en.t: His first impression of the Imperial Library was vivid: he was afraid of the high ceiling, afraid of the tall windows, and afraid of the countless readers filling the countless chairs.

units.source_text: 但是，幸亏在去了两三次后，这种害怕就逐渐消失了。

en.t: Fortunately, after he had gone there two or three times, that fear gradually disappeared.

units.source_text: 很快，他就对阅览室、铁梯子、书卡柜子、地下食堂有了亲切感受。

en.t: Before long, he began to feel affection for the reading room, the iron ladders, the card cabinets, and the basement cafeteria.

units.source_text: 后来，他也会使用大学和高中的学校图书馆。

en.t: Later, he also came to use the school libraries of universities and high schools.

units.source_text: 在数百本书籍里，他最喜欢的有几十本书，但是——

en.t: Among the hundreds of books, there were several dozen that he liked best, but...
